resources.string: 验证 TextView 背景标签、引用框、代码块、描边框和强调背景的显示效果。
This page compares TextView background treatments used in guide pages: inline tags, quote boxes, code blocks, outlined notes, and warning-style emphasis.
A soft quote box can make an important idea stand out without feeling like an error state.
Outlined TextView: transparent fill, visible border, useful for comparing boundaries and padding.
Warning-style background: higher contrast for notes that should catch attention.
